name: lodash-merge-customizer-opt-merger
behavioral_change: lodash v4.0.0 moved the customizer capability of `_.merge` into `_.mergeWith`. Under v_new a function passed as the third argument to `_.merge` is no longer treated as a customizer but as another source object; since a function has no own enumerable properties, the result is identical to omitting it.
downstream_effect: The downstream project calls `_.merge(defaults, toMerge, customizer)` in index.js:71 so that arrays are merged by union; after the upgrade arrays are overwritten index by index. The five failures are deepEqual assertions in test/merge.callbacks.js and test/merge.simple.js, a different file from the one that must be edited, and the output never mentions lodash, mergeWith or customizer.
reference_fix: The reference fix replaces `_.merge(_.cloneDeep(defaults), toMerge, customizer)` with `_.mergeWith(...)` in index.js:71.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog for v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), Compatibility Warnings section, "Split out methods" list, states "Split `_.merge` into `_.mergeWith`" with no accompanying code; the new call form must be derived from the `_.mergeWith` API reference (https://lodash.com/docs/4.17.21#mergeWith), whose customizer takes (objValue, srcValue) as in v_old.
